children: Invesco Mortgage Capital swung to a common-stockholder loss from income a year earlier as a steep decline in mortgage-backed securities’ fair value outweighed higher net interest income and gains on derivatives. The company cited rising interest rates and wider spreads for the investment losses.
² Reported as “Net income (loss) attributable to common stockholders”. ³ Reported as “Diluted”.
: Increased to $33.9M from $17.6M, driven by higher average earning assets and a lower cost of funds.
: Net unrealized MBS losses were $398.4M, compared with $48.3M in net unrealized gains a year earlier.
: Net gains were $277.7M, compared with $9.2M in net losses in 3Q 2025.
: Agency RMBS made up approximately 83% of the investment portfolio, including TBAs, as of September 30, 2026; TBAs were approximately 8%.
